Hi Priya / Horizon security team —

I joined the slot on our calendar just now but it looks like the meeting didn’t connect on your side. No worries — these things happen. I wanted to follow up quickly so we don’t lose momentum on the questionnaire walkthrough.

Short summary of where we were planning to get to:
- Walk through the SOC 2 questionnaire row-by-row for your security team
- Confirm where you need supporting artifacts (logs, policies, KMS details)
- Agree on a delivery timeline for any evidence requests

Proposed next steps (pick one):
1) Rebook a 30-minute walkthrough — here are open slots on my calendar this week: Mon 6/1 09:00–09:30 PT, Tue 6/2 09:00–09:30 PT, Tue 6/2 14:00–14:30 PT.
2) If you prefer, send a time that works for your security lead and we’ll match it.
3) I’ve attached the latest SOC 2 QnA workbook (Redwood_SOC2_QnA_v2.xlsx) so your team can pre-fill rows before the call — that will make the session faster.

Quick ask: if someone else on your side should own the reschedule, please loop them into the reply so we can confirm immediately.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes

- To make the walkthrough efficient, could Vijay pre-fill the following tabs in the attached workbook before the call: "Access Controls", "Data Residency", and "Logging & Retention"? We’ll focus live on any gaps.
